activities.text: Ran the schedule audit in the rain — Con Law, LRW and Contracts all at PACI, stale fridge alert cleared off the wall
Posted the George brief for Rheia's Morning Show — superhero school and the Constitution today
Texted Angie the Wednesday overview and pushed the morning dash live
Morning briefing out — Margarine and EMA on the Con Law list, heavy rain and a rainfall warning all day
Recorded the drive-time podcast — Margarine and the pipeline permit, cold-call ready for nine
Out to PACI for Con Law — parked at the church lot and set a timer in my head
Moved the car to the parkade at the changeover, then straight into LRW with the McGill Guide
Midday drive-time recorded — intention, seals and the writing requirement before Contracts
Contracts at PACI — Week 7 material finally landed, and an IPC assignment is coming November 16
New driveway dates landed — prep November 12, paving the 13th, park next door from the 11th. Alert pushed, reminder set
Stock-up run straight from PACI — Wholesale Club for drinks, Superstore for the haul, freezer rock solid again
Dinner settled at last: Chinese Burger pastries from the haul, baked in the oven — nobody was washing the air fryer
Filed the three Indigenous reading summaries for tomorrow and ticked the tasks off — homework reduced to a skim
Published tonight's Diary post, 'Make It Squircles More' — then lights low, family tree at 107 people, time to recharge
